shared_elements: standing human figure with raised/outstretched arms
rows of repeated short vertical strokes (comb-like or fringe-like band)
motifs stacked in horizontal registers on a vertical surface
justification: Both surfaces distribute schematic silhouette figures — profile quadrupeds, small frontal humans with raised arms, and bands of repeated short vertical strokes — into loosely stacked horizontal tiers on an upright face, which gives a generic register-based likeness. But the techniques and resulting impressions differ fundamentally: A is deep three-dimensional relief carving in pale stone with tightly framed, contiguous animal registers, while B is flat red pigment scattered with wide empty intervals over speckled grey rock and dominated by long hull-and-crew forms absent from A.
